capabilities: Preview the active note as a side-by-side Chirr-style thread
Slice text into 280-character posts without splitting words
Start new thread cards with manual [...] split markers
Show real-time character counters and highlight posts over the limit
disambiguation: Despite the name, it only drafts and previews threads inside Obsidian; it does not post to Twitter or any service.
extras: Installation is manual: files must be downloaded from GitHub Releases and copied into the plugin folder; no usage examples or screenshots are provided.
intentEvidence: Write social threads from Obsidian notes with a live Chirr-style preview
problem: Drafting social media threads from notes requires leaving Obsidian or manually counting characters and deciding where each post breaks.
summary: Thread composer that previews the active note as a social thread with word-aware 280-character slicing, split markers, and character counters.
